attchmntText: Vardhman Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Vardhman Holdings Limited published its financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 in Desh Sewak and Financial Express on 11 November 2026. Kalpataru Engineering Limited reported a net loss of 2.020 lakhs for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Hamilton Poles Manufacturing Co Ltd reported a net profit of 0.350 lakhs for the same period. National General Industries Limited reported a net profit of 13.19 lakhs for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. MPS Limited seeks shareholder approval via postal ballot for the re-appointment of Ms. Divya as a director. TAI Industries Limited reported a net profit of 151.90 lakhs for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.

attchmntText: Vardhman Holdings Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Vardhman Holdings Limited submitted its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, to the BSE and NSE. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on November 10, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, standalone profit for the period was Rs. 58.32 Crores, compared to Rs. 35.87 Crores in the same period last year. Consolidated profit for the half year was Rs. 209.52 Crores, up from Rs. 108.70 Crores previously. Standalone basic earnings per share for the half year was Rs. 182.70, while consolidated basic earnings per share stood at Rs. 656.46. The statutory auditors, K.C. Khanna & Co., issued an unmodified review conclusion on the financial results.
